records.response_truth: Pick it up. Answer it. Now.

And we need to set up a proper watch schedule. It's not safe for us to be drifting apart like this. Let's stick together and make the best of this situation.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.

records.response_truth:

Keep the food. Distribute it fairly before the rescue team gets here or don't, up to you. Just don't insult us by pretending it was purely strategic.
records.response_pred: Alright, where is it? Let's take a look. If it's useful, we can add it to the rationing plan.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly? Not much on the practical side. The water run, the raft, the signals — that stuff was solid.

I'd have caught the hoarding earlier. Should have been paying closer attention in the first couple of days instead of waiting for Michelangelo to notice things.

And I'd have spent less time managing everyone's emotions and more time just letting people be what they are. DaVinci's going to draw flowers on the beach, Michelangelo's going to sit with his fear, you're going to log everything in a notebook. That's just who you all are. Took me a day or two longer than it should have to stop fighting that and just work with it.

records.response_pred: I'd say we should have started gathering resources as soon as we landed. We wasted precious time not getting organized right away. But overall, I'm proud of what we've accomplished so far and I think we can make it through this together.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.
records.response_truth:

Send me a copy when it's done. Genuinely curious what it looks like laid out properly. Might be useful for something, who knows.
records.response_pred: Yeah, okay. Makes sense. Just remember to include the rationing plan and the water sources we've found. Keep it clear and concise, we're not trying to write a novel here. And if we find any more useful stuff while you're out, let us know. No point in us all going out and tripping over each other.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?

None. That's the point.

He wasn't doing it for a practical purpose, he was doing it because it kept him human. Kept all of us human honestly. You can't run on pure survival logic for five days without losing something.

The flowers stayed.
records.response_pred: They're not really for a practical purpose, they're more for hope and morale. So, in a way, they could help with rescue. But mostly, it's just a way to cope.
